text:
maria: Hey team — heads up I just got hit with a delayed flight, need someone to cover the overnight oncall window Sat 18:00-02:00 PST. I can still do the first hour until 19:00 if that helps. Sorry for the short notice :grimacing:

sandeep: I can pick up 20:00-02:00. happy to take on the heavier bit. @maria can you DM me any hot endpoints you were watching? :thumbsup:

jess: I can do 18:00-20:00 to bridge. no worries. Can you post a short handoff list for the key things?

maria: Thanks both! Quick handoff notes below — followup in thread: 
- Primary cluster: aws-us-west-2 (prod-inference-a). watch latency spikes on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings routes.
- Known risk: KV cache invalidation during rolling deploys causes a burst of cold-cache requests; if p95 tokens/sec > 4k, consider throttling new requests or flip to fallback model.
- Quick commands:
```
# check inference pods
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=redwood-inference
# tail logs for a pod
kubectl -n inference logs -f pod/redwood-inference-xxxxx
# restart inference service on vm fallback
ssh ops@10.10.10.5 'sudo systemctl restart redwood-inference'
```
- Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-inference (watch the "cache storm" section)
- Escalation: ping platform-oncall then eng-sre if not acknowledged in 10m.

noah: Re: KV cache — if you see error patterns like `KVCacheMissError` in logs, try toggling `ENABLE_PREFETCH=false` in the runtime env for the node pool (short-lived), monitor error rates for 5m before reverting. I can be on standby if you need that flipped.

sandeep: Got it. i'll take metrics watch and alerts. jess — can you take ownership of incident triage if anything looks like model OOM or severe latency?

jess: Yep, i'll handle triage. I'll also post screenshots of the metrics if anything weird.

maria: One more: there might be a small config rollout tonight (auto-scaling policy tweak). If that hits, watch replica counts and pod restarts — we had a flaky autoscaler last week.

sandeep: noted. i'll keep an eye on HPA and the rollout window. If we see >2 restarts in 10m, i'll roll back the HPA change.

maria: Thanks all — leaving contact in case my phone dies: maria@phone/email. Appreciate the cover. :pray:

deploy-bot: Schedule update: maria removed from Sat 18:00-02:00; jess assigned 18:00-20:00; sandeep assigned 20:00-02:00. Pager duty: platform-oncall set as secondary.

jess: confirmed on the schedule. i'll create a quick doc snippet in #incidents if we need to timeline anything.

sandeep: pulling up dashboards now. ping me in thread if you want me to run the ENABLE_PREFETCH flip.

maria: thanks again — will check in tomorrow AM with any loose ends. safe weekend all. :slightly_smiling_face:
